name: design-starter-kit-website
description: Gleam and Lustre design starter kit with Sass styling.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n sass,lustre -c blue,green "npm:scss -- --watch" "env PATH=$HOME/.local/opt/erlang-28/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH gleam run -m lustre/dev start"
scripts.build: npm run scss && env PATH=$HOME/.local/opt/erlang-28/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH gleam run -m lustre/dev build && find dist -type f \( -name '*.scss' -o -name '.gitkeep' \) -delete
